ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigment across the entire visible surface with high-contrast white linear clusters concentrated on the left lobe and white mottling localized at the distal lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped depression with a central angle of approximately 50 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with moderate-frequency peaks and valleys (amplitude 2-5 pixels) along the continuous trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a steep upward convex trajectory; right lobe displays a broad convex curvature partially truncated by the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast white clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) scattered on the left lobe and concentrated at the far right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering approximately 40% of the left lobe surface and 20% of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (likely odontocete-induced) across the ventral surface; significant white scarring/callous tissue at both distal lateral tips.
